exposure: Oxytocin titration for postdates labor induction
cohort: 280 women who received oxytocin for postdates labor induction
finding: Obese women received more oxytocin, experienced longer labor, and had higher cesarean birth rates compared to non-obese women undergoing postdates labor induction.
mod_finding: Obese women had higher cesarean birth rates compared to non-obese women undergoing postdates labor induction.
